table.name: frpm
table.purpose: California school-level Free or Reduced-Price Meals (FRPM) / National School Lunch Program eligibility data for academic year 2014-2015, one row per public school (CDS code). Contains enrollment, free meal and FRPM counts and percentages, plus school/district/county identification and charter/provision status. Joins to schools via CDSCode.

2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Sta.name: CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status (2013-14)
2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Sta.description: Flag indicating the school's CALPADS Fall 1 enrollment submission was certified; constant value 1 (certified) for all rows, so it carries no discriminating information.

Academic Year.name: Academic Year
Academic Year.description: Academic year the data covers; constant '2014-2015' for all rows.

CDSCode.name: CDS Code
CDSCode.description: California Department of Education County-District-School code, a 14-digit identifier (county 2 digits + district 5 digits + school 7 digits). Primary key of this table; joins one-to-one to schools.CDSCode.

Charter Funding Type.name: Charter Funding Type
Charter Funding Type.description: How a charter school is funded: 'Directly funded' (receives state funds directly) or 'Locally funded' (funded through its district). Null for non-charter schools (~88% null). 'Not in CS funding model' for one school not in the charter funding model.

Charter School (Y/N).name: Charter School Indicator
Charter School (Y/N).description: 1 if the school is a charter school, 0 otherwise.

Charter School Number.name: Charter School Number
Charter School Number.description: State-assigned charter school number (4-digit code, e.g. '00D2'). Populated only for charter schools (~12% of rows).

County Code.name: County Code
County Code.description: Two-digit California county code (1-58); matches the first two digits of the CDS code.

County Name.name: County Name
County Name.description: Name of the California county (e.g. Los Angeles, San Diego).

District Code.name: District Code
District Code.description: Five-digit code of the school district (or county office of education / other administrative unit); matches digits 3-7 of the CDS code.

District Name.name: District Name
District Name.description: Name of the district or administrative unit the school belongs to (e.g. Los Angeles Unified).

District Type.name: District Type
District Type.description: Type of administrative unit: Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District, County Office of Education, State Board of Education, Non-School Locations, etc.

Educational Option Type.name: Educational Option Type
Educational Option Type.description: Programmatic type of the school: Traditional, Continuation School, Alternative School of Choice, Community Day School, Special Education School, Juvenile Court School, Home and Hospital, etc.

Enrollment (Ages 5-17).name: Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
Enrollment (Ages 5-17).description: Number of students enrolled at the school aged 5-17 (used for FRPM eligibility rate calculations).

Enrollment (K-12).name: Enrollment (K-12)
Enrollment (K-12).description: Number of students enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12 at the school.

FRPM Count (Ages 5-17).name: FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)
FRPM Count (Ages 5-17).description: Number of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free or reduced-price meals.

FRPM Count (K-12).name: FRPM Count (K-12)
FRPM Count (K-12).description: Number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.

Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17).name: Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)
Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17).description: Number of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free meals (a subset of the FRPM count).

Free Meal Count (K-12).name: Free Meal Count (K-12)
Free Meal Count (K-12).description: Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals (a subset of the FRPM count).

High Grade.name: High Grade
High Grade.description: Highest grade level served by the school: 'K' for kindergarten-only, 1-12, and 13 (ungraded/adult).

IRC.name: IRC (Serves IRC Students)
IRC.description: Flag, likely indicating whether the school serves students in a Juvenile Court / Institutional (IRC) setting or is an IRC-funded school; 1 for ~7% of rows. The exact expansion of 'IRC' is not evidenced by the data alone.

Low Grade.name: Low Grade
Low Grade.description: Lowest grade level served: 'P' for preschool/pre-kindergarten, 'K' for kindergarten, or 1-12.

NSLP Provision Status.name: NSLP Provision Status
NSLP Provision Status.description: National School Lunch Program special provision status of the school: Provision 1/2/3, Breakfast Provision 2, CEP (Community Eligibility Provision), or Multiple Provision Types. Null for schools without a special provision (~82%).

Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17).name: Percent Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)
Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17).description: Share of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free or reduced-price meals, stored as a fraction 0-1 (e.g. 0.63 = 63%).

Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12).name: Percent Eligible FRPM (K-12)
Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12).description: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals, stored as a fraction 0-1.

Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17).name: Percent Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)
Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17).description: Share of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free meals, stored as a fraction 0-1.

Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12).name: Percent Eligible Free (K-12)
Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12).description: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals, stored as a fraction 0-1.

School Code.name: School Code
School Code.description: Seven-digit school code; matches the last seven digits of the CDS code. '0000000' (45 rows) corresponds to 'District Office' rows, i.e. district-level records without a specific school.

School Name.name: School Name
School Name.description: Name of the school (e.g. Lincoln Elementary); 'District Office' for district-level records.

School Type.name: School Type
School Type.description: Broad category of the school: Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public), Continuation High Schools, Alternative Schools of Choice, K-12 Schools (Public), etc.

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: California school-level SAT test results: average scores and counts of test-takers and students scoring 1500+, reported per school (rtype 'S') or per district/county-level aggregate (rtype 'D'), keyed by CDS code which links to the schools table.

AvgScrMath.name: average SAT math score
AvgScrMath.description: School/aggregate average SAT math section score (200-800 range observed: 289-699). Null when no scores reported (e.g., too few test takers).

AvgScrRead.name: average SAT critical reading score
AvgScrRead.description: Average SAT reading section score (observed 308-653). Null when no scores reported.

AvgScrWrite.name: average SAT writing score
AvgScrWrite.description: Average SAT writing section score (observed 312-671). Null when no scores reported.

NumGE1500.name: number of test takers scoring 1500 or above
NumGE1500.description: Count of students whose total SAT score was >= 1500 (out of 2400). Null when no scores reported.

NumTstTakr.name: number of SAT test takers
NumTstTakr.description: Count of grade-12 students who took the SAT at this school/aggregate.

cds.name: CDS code
cds.description: California Department of Education County-District-School code; unique per row, one-to-one with schools.CDSCode.

cname.name: county name
cname.description: Name of the California county (e.g., Los Angeles, San Diego).

dname.name: district name
dname.description: Name of the school district or county office of education (e.g., 'Los Angeles Unified').

enroll12.name: grade 12 enrollment
enroll12.description: Number of students enrolled in grade 12 at the school/aggregate.

rtype.name: record type
rtype.description: 'S' = school-level record, 'D' = district/aggregate-level record (sname null for D rows).

sname.name: school name
sname.description: Name of the school; null for district-level (rtype 'D') rows.

table.name: schools
table.purpose: California public schools directory (CDE-style): one row per school/site with location, contacts, district/county, type codes, grade spans, charter/magnet/virtual flags, open/close dates and status. Joined by CDSCode to frpm and satscores.

AdmEmail1.name: administrator_email_1
AdmEmail1.description: Email of the school's primary administrator

AdmEmail2.name: administrator_email_2
AdmEmail2.description: Email of a second administrator (rarely populated)

AdmEmail3.name: administrator_email_3
AdmEmail3.description: Email of a third administrator (almost never populated)

AdmFName1.name: administrator_first_name_1
AdmFName1.description: First name of the primary administrator

AdmFName2.name: administrator_first_name_2
AdmFName2.description: First name of a second administrator

AdmFName3.name: administrator_first_name_3
AdmFName3.description: First name of a third administrator

AdmLName1.name: administrator_last_name_1
AdmLName1.description: Last name of the primary administrator

AdmLName2.name: administrator_last_name_2
AdmLName2.description: Last name of a second administrator

AdmLName3.name: administrator_last_name_3
AdmLName3.description: Last name of a third administrator

CDSCode.name: cds_code
CDSCode.description: 14-digit CDE County-District-School code; primary key, referenced by frpm.CDSCode and satscores.cds

Charter.name: is_charter
Charter.description: 1 if the school is a charter school, else 0

CharterNum.name: charter_number
CharterNum.description: State-issued charter school number (only for charter schools)

City.name: city
City.description: City of the school's physical location

ClosedDate.name: closed_date
ClosedDate.description: Date the school closed (null for open schools)

DOC.name: district_organization_code
DOC.description: Two-digit code for the district organization type; pairs with DOCType

DOCType.name: district_organization_type
DOCType.description: Label for DOC (e.g. Unified School District, County Office of Education)

District.name: district_name
District.description: Name of the district the school belongs to

EILCode.name: educational_instruction_level_code
EILCode.description: Code for the school's instructional level; pairs with EILName

EILName.name: educational_instruction_level
EILName.description: Label for EILCode (Elementary, High School, Ungraded, etc.)

EdOpsCode.name: educational_option_code
EdOpsCode.description: Code for the school's educational option/program type; pairs with EdOpsName

EdOpsName.name: educational_option
EdOpsName.description: Label for EdOpsCode (Traditional, Continuation, Community Day, etc.)

Ext.name: phone_extension
Ext.description: Phone extension for the school (mostly null; some values look like full numbers, so a few entries may be miskeyed)

FundingType.name: charter_funding_type
FundingType.description: Charter school funding model: Directly funded, Locally funded, or not in the charter funding model

GSoffered.name: grades_offered
GSoffered.description: Range of grade levels offered at the school (e.g. K-5, 9-12)

GSserved.name: grades_served
GSserved.description: Range of grade levels actually served (may be narrower than offered)

LastUpdate.name: last_update_date
LastUpdate.description: Date the record was last updated in the directory

Latitude.name: latitude
Latitude.description: Latitude of the school location (decimal degrees)

Longitude.name: longitude
Longitude.description: Longitude of the school location (decimal degrees, negative = west)

Magnet.name: is_magnet
Magnet.description: 1 if the school is a magnet school, else 0

MailCity.name: mailing_city
MailCity.description: City of the school's mailing address

MailState.name: mailing_state
MailState.description: State of the mailing address (always CA)

MailStrAbr.name: mailing_street_abbreviated
MailStrAbr.description: Mailing street address with abbreviated street types (Dr., St., Ave.)

MailZip.name: mailing_zip
MailZip.description: ZIP code (with +4 where present) of the mailing address

NCESDist.name: nces_district_id
NCESDist.description: 7-digit NCES district ID (state prefix 06 + district code)

NCESSchool.name: nces_school_id
NCESSchool.description: 5-digit NCES school ID within the district

OpenDate.name: open_date
OpenDate.description: Date the school opened (1980-07-01 is a default/unknown placeholder for older schools)

SOC.name: school_type_code
SOC.description: Two-digit code for the school type (School Type code); pairs with SOCType

SOCType.name: school_type
SOCType.description: Label for SOC (Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), etc.)

State.name: state
State.description: State of the physical location (always CA)

StatusType.name: status
StatusType.description: School status: Active, Closed, Merged, or Pending

Street.name: street
Street.description: Physical street address of the school, spelled out

StreetAbr.name: street_abbreviated
StreetAbr.description: Physical street address with abbreviated street types

Virtual.name: virtual_school_flag
Virtual.description: Whether the school provides online/virtual instruction: N = no, P = partial, F = full (inferred from code values; exact CDE definitions not in data)

Zip.name: zip
Zip.description: ZIP code (with +4 where present) of the physical location
